set-variable.name: piiInputStatus

return-response.set-body: @(new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(new JProperty("code", (int)context.Variables["piiInputStatus"] == 413 ? "PiiInputTooLarge" : "PiiInvalidInput"))), new JProperty("requestId", context.RequestId.ToString())).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None))

set-variable.name: piiRetryAfter
piiResult

policies.on-error:
__RATE_LIMIT_ERROR_XML__
@(context.RequestId.ToString()) application/json no-store @(new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(new JProperty("code", (int)context.Variables["gatewayAuditStatus"] == 401 ? "PiiAuthenticationFailed" : (int)context.Variables["gatewayAuditStatus"] == 504 ? "PiiTimeout" : "PiiUpstreamFailure"))), new JProperty("requestId", context.RequestId.ToString())).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None))
